author: PackRat 🐀
name: Market Command Center
description: Your watchlist, live on your dashboard. Pin S&P 500, Nasdaq 100 and Dow ETF proxies at the top, track stocks and crypto side by side, and see prices, daily movement and rolling charts at a glance. Crypto works immediately; stocks use your own Finnhub API key. Keeps showing last known prices when the connection drops.
